lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: For the sake of secrecy, shall we dispose of her?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: What!?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Just kidding.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Why bother killing you when I can just wipe your memory?
... All right, enough with the scary talk.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Hey, what the hell are you wearing?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: You gonna join the event or what?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Yeah, I was planning to, but...
Bay, we've got a lot on our plates right now, so...

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: The outfit...
Huh?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: That's actually not a bad idea.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Changing outfits, I mean.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: First off, Milk, you stand out far too much right now.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Me? Why?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: For starters, what you're wearing now

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: is practically battle-ready.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Well duh! I've gotta be geared up and combat-ready!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: You're also quite well-known.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: If you keep showing up around the target often, you'll definitely draw suspicion.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: After all, you're none other than the Scavenger from Cafe Sweety.
... Good point.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Fine, whatever. I'll just throw on

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: sunglasses and a mask like Pal. Happy now?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Yes. I don't think a full mask is necessary, but I do think some degree of disguise is needed.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Then, here. I'll give you something to change into.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Ah, right. Since this is a storage unit, they might have... that...?
Milk freezes the moment she sees the box Exia sets down.
Inside the box...

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: ... Hey! What the heck is this?!
... are various kinds of bunny girl outfits.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Bunny girl outfits, obviously.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: A bunny girl outfit? Are you freakin' serious?!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Ehh...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: If not now, when else are you gonna get the chance to wear something like this?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: And with the event going on,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Coin Rush is teeming with bunny girls,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: so this'll actually let you blend right in.
That's a fair point.
I'm not so sure about that...
*Rustle*

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: ... There's really a ton of varieties here.
Bay pulls the costumes out from the box and lays them out.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Do you always have this many lying around?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: We keep some on hand for guests who want to rent costumes during events,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: but we received an unusually large batch this time around.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Apparently, they were special orders.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Ooooh!
Exia picks up one of the costumes.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I'll go with this one.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It looks like there's a computer built into it!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Wait, you've decided on one already?!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: ... I was puzzled as to why today's lucky item was a bunny girl outfit.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Now it all makes sense...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Then, let's get right to it. Initiating bunny girl transformation!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Hey, what the heck! Pal's right here! What are you doing?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Aw, that's too bad, Noob.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: That was your chance to admire my rockin' bod.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Even for a bunny girl suit, this one's a bit much... *Sigh*

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Can I really pull this off?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Hey! What the heck are you spacing out for again?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Um... Coach?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: What exactly is going on here?
It's like an ideal situation.
I'm not entirely sure myself...

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: O-okay...

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: ... I'm sorry, Highroller, but could you please wait outside for a moment?
... Got it. Let me know when you're all do—

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I can't take it anymore. Transform!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Aaaaaah!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Pal! Get out, now!
The moment I see Exia grab her hem, I turn around and dart out of the storage unit.
*Click*
What in the world is going on in there?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Damn, that scared the crap outta me.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Tell me about it...

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: ... You're still here, huh?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: I couldn't quite find the right moment to leave...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Ughhh...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: How do you even wear this thing?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Oh, I'll show you. Wait a sec.
*Rustle*

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Hold up, you're wearing one too?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: This... is my lucky outfit for today.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: What's that? Let me see... Oh.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Whoa, wait! You're seriously gonna wear that?!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Are you sure that's something you wear, and not just slap on?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: That's because it's my lucky... outfit.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Lucky outfit my ass! You're a lunatic for going out in that!

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: Peeeeeerfect!

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: I can feel an overwhelming sense of omnipotence...

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Milk, this one's yours.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Huh? What?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: I think this'll suit you best.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: ... Screw it. I give up.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Fine, what exactly is it about this one that you think'll suit m—

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: What?! You expect me to wear THIS?!

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Here, Exia, I'll help brush your hair for you.

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: Oh yeah!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Ugh... am I seriously wearing this thing right?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Start with the stockings first.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: I-I know that much, all right?

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: ... Seriously, why are these heels so freaking high?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: When you're all dressed, I'll do your hair and makeup.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: N-no way, I don't need that!

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: You'd look real strange if you wore that outfit without any makeup.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: Of course it's pigtails.

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: When it comes to changing your image, pigtails are a must-have.

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: Now, this...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: ... Hey!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: You seriously call that fully dressed?! You're literally half naked!

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: ... No, not yet.

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: I still need to attach this.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: ... A-are you sure you're okay with this?

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: ... Yes, I'll manage somehow.

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: ... Let's finish up quickly. Highroller is waiting.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Y-yeah. Now I just need to do Milk's makeup.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Sigh... Fine, do whatever you want.
After a good while,
I hear Rouge call me in, so I step back into the storage unit.
There...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: All right, Pal. Let's get right to it...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: What the, why's your face so red?
Er... w-well...
... You all look great.
I'm really glad to be alive...

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: As expected, Noob's got taste.

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: Pigtail mode, activate!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Wh-who cares about that crap right now!?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Coach, you've got a weird look in your eyes...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: What kind of weird-ass pervy line was that, anyway?!
And then...
my gaze very naturally drift toward Rouge.

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: ... Why are you looking at me like that, Highroller?
Um...
... It's nothing.
... Are you sure you'll be okay?

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: ... Yes.
Rouge blushes and adjusts the hem of her shirt slightly.

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: Because it's just... a lucky item, after all.
O-okay.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: All right, looks like you're finally back to your senses, Pal.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Let's set this place up as our base and start drawing up a plan.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Hey, Rouge. Where are the computers and monitors?

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: One moment, please.
... Just then,
the door opens, and someone enters the storage unit.
*Clunk*
... Huh?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: ... M-Master?!
